svg.title: The M DevBox stack
svg.desc: One container holding, from the top: your browser, with VS Code, the m-vscode extension and an AI assistant; your code; M StdLib, the M Standard Library; M CLI, the m command; the M driver; and the M Engine, YottaDB with its database.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M DevBox: the whole M stack in one container
